definitionZh: 网格柱启动 CSS 属性指定网格项在网格柱内的起始位置,方法是贡献一条线,一个跨度,或者在其网格位置上没有任何(自动). 此起始位置定义了网格区域的块启动边缘.
sourceDefinition: The grid-column-start CSS property specifies a grid item's start position within the grid column by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement. This start position defines the block-start edge of the grid areas.
